verdict.rationale: EBANX documents a sandbox environment selected by environment-specific endpoints, with request paths identical across tenants, and a test credit card table giving ready-to-use card objects, expected sandbox responses, and 3DS indicators. Its integration prompt also targets sandbox setup. Decline outcomes are only implied by the per-card expected responses, and nothing shows dispute or chargeback simulation in sandbox. missing for 10: explicit decline test cards, dispute/chargeback test scenarios, evidence that sandbox mirrors production behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
